description: Weighed mixtures of 2-3 commercial precursors (Aeris, Cu K-alpha); 2-min and 8-min scans. Ground-truth wt% are the weighed masses encoded in the file names (e.g. 0p3022 = 0.3022 g), renormalised to 100 wt%.

Li4CO5.note: ICSD 181261 is Li2CO3 mislabelled as Li4CO5 (benchmark sheet note).
